mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_logs ( payment_id, user_id, payment_status, payment_method, amount, currency, provider_transaction_id, notification_type, delivery_status, correlation_id, created_at ) VALUES ( #{paymentId}, #{userId}, #{paymentStatus, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{paymentMethod, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{amount}, #{currency}, #{providerTransactionId}, #{notificationType}, #{deliveryStatus}, #{correlationId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
